pages.reviewNotes: Audited FY2025 consolidated IFRS statements printed pp. 99–100: SEK million revenue 10,442, EBIT 993, owner earnings 560 and owner equity 5,443. Total earnings 562 and total equity 5,447 include non-controlling interests. Printed pp. 30–31 report a SEK 159.10 B-share closing price, 122,450,250 A and B shares including 586,189 own B shares, and approximately SEK 19,482m market capitalisation. The company-reported amount is consistent with valuing all A and B shares at the B-share price; the A shares are unlisted. Wisdom pretax profit agrees, while EBIT is SEK 213m lower with a corresponding difference in net financial items. Reported net other operating income is also SEK 213m; the actual source-row mapping remains unverified.
